paragraphs: Rabbi Avin bar Chiyya (Zevachim 9a) asked Rabbi Avin bar Kahana (Temurah 20, end of b). Rabbi Ila. He asked Rabbi Zeira, Jerusalem Talmud; asked Ze'ira, Jerusalem Talmud, Ketubbot, chapter 4, halakhah 4. Before Resh Lakish, in bar Rav Yitzchak’s name [בש״ר ברב יצחק; chain unclear], Terumot, chapter 6. Rabbi Yirmeyah in Rabbi Abba bar Mammal’s name; Rabbi Nasa in his name; in Rabbi Shmuel bar Abba’s name, Tamid Nishchat, halakhah 2, and Shekalim, chapter 2, halakhah 5. Rabbi Shammai. There is also Chiyya bar Avin.
